summary: Thin dispatch wrapper: sets bit 0 at byte offset a2 of this by forwarding &this[a2] to BitFlagSetter. The wrapper provides the byte-level flag address for the generic setter; used by the entity visibility grid manager.

operations.description: Form the target address as a byte offset from this: &this[a2].
Call BitFlagSetter(&this[a2], 1) to set the flag bit.

unresolved: What the single bit flag set at byte offset a2 represents in the entity visibility grid is not known from this function.
